  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  MEMORIAL HEIGHTS CONFERENCE ROOM, 10TH FL, 1:45 PM

Blair Cohn, Commissioner
Walter Larkins, Commissioner
Austin Metoyer, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  CARLA.HENDY-ANGUIANO@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE VIA:
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55460 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee meeting of Wednesday, August 7, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55461 Recommendation to approve the revolving loan application in the amount of $75,000
  for Bridge High, dba Homareya, located at 145 East 4th Street, Long Beach, CA.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101.

announced that Comissioner Cohn was excused from the meeting.
